note: Export side is factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: 5 concrete export bills of lading between 2026-01-29 and 2026-02-20, destinations Oman, Turkey, Thailand and South Korea (two), with HS codes 28363000, 28332990, 29181520 and 28273990. Note the declared HS set (282720; 282739; 310420) only partially matches the observed records: 28273990 is confirmed, but 282720 and 310420 do not appear in any of the five visible rows, while 28363000, 28332990 and 29181520 appear and are absent from the declared list — per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the actual codes should be recorded as observed. Also note the shipper name on record is 'NANDU CHEMICAL INDUSTRIES' while the goods line states 'MFG BY NANDU CHEMICALS PVT. LTD', i.e. the exporter entity and the manufacturer entity appear to be related but distinct names; the second slug variant (nandu-chemicals-pvt-ltd) returned an empty page with no shipment rows, so the 266-record figure belongs to the 'NANDU CHEMICAL INDUSTRIES' profile only. Revenue and export volume in value terms: null — ImportKey free view shows record counts, not values, and no financials were retrievable. Domestic (intra-India) supply: no evidence found either way, status unknown rather than none_found, because the searches were blocked rather than exhausted.
